Hive and Spark ALTER TABLE ... REPLACE COLUMNS (col type [COMMENT ...], ...) [CASCADE|RESTRICT] falls back to a generic Command. It should parse into an exp.Alter whose action is a dedicated REPLACE COLUMNS node, and round-trip; column definitions sqlglot cannot parse yet should keep falling back to a Command.

For example:

type(parse_one("ALTER TABLE X REPLACE COLUMNS (y INT COMMENT 'c', z STRING) CASCADE", read="hive")).__name__

# expected:  Alter
